title: Claim Petition before the Controlling Authority / Labour Commissioner under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 and Payment of Wages Act, 1936
whenToUse: Use when filing a formal claim petition before the Controlling Authority / Labour Commissioner for recovery of unpaid gratuity, wages, or statutory retrenchment compensation.
variantComparisonNote: Statutory claim petition before Labour Authority. Distinct from pre-litigation advocate notice.
youWillNeed: Service certificate, appointment letter, Form I gratuity demand copy with postal proof, pay slips.
legalBasis: Sections 4, 7 & 8 Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972; Section 15 Payment of Wages Act, 1936; Payment of Gratuity (Central) Rules, 1972.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Proof of continuous service of 5 years or qualifying tenure
Prior service of Form I notice of gratuity demand on employer
Failure of employer to pay within 30 days of termination
Statutory prayer for compound interest under Section 7(3A) of Gratuity Act

particulars.label: Completed Service Tenure
particulars.description: Number of completed years of service

aiBlocks.title: Service Record & Cessation of Employment
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate employment tenure of {{FACT:service_tenure_years}} years by {{FACT:claimant_employee_name}}, qualifying continuous service, last drawn wages, and cessation date.

aiBlocks.title: Statutory Entitlement & Employer Non-Compliance
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Calculate statutory gratuity and wage liability, service of Form I demand, and respondent's unlawful withholding violating Section 7 of Gratuity Act.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Recovery Certificate & Penal Interest
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft statutory prayer for recovery certificate under Section 8, 10% compound interest under Section 7(3A), and recovery through District Collector as land revenue.
